name: ultra-modern-lovable-style
purpose: Canonical reference pattern bundled with Lintel as schema-by-example. Serves as the baseline for operator-extracted patterns via /li:frontend-style-extract. L-001 trade-off explicitly acknowledged: re-evaluate after Phase D dogfood if operator-extracted patterns dominate the vault (>3 patterns), can demote to docs/samples/.
visual_thesis_distilled: Editorial-grade modern AI-app aesthetic: Fraunces serif (variable optical-size) carries editorial gravitas in display + headings, Inter handles dense body precision, GSAP+ScrollTrigger drives a hero-act + section-fade-up choreography smoothed by Lenis, shadcn primitives augmented by Aceternity for motion-cards + tracing-beam effects, Paper Shaders provides a low-complexity mesh-gradient hero background. The result reads as Lovable-grade — production-ready, modern, restrained.
